verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for an app that sends staged diffs to OpenAI, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that AI features are opt-in, and opt-in consent is an adjacent control, not control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted. Git-level operations like Delete Commit are version-control features, not privacy retention controls, and nothing documents retention periods or deletion of data sent to the AI provider.
